name: Session Restore
author: David Reed
description: Save every open window - app, workspace, monitor, size, floating/fullscreen state and browser tabs - as a named session, and bring it back on demand or automatically at login. Pin one session and the plugin's service half reopens it a few seconds after each Hyprland start; once per login, not on a mid-session shell restart. Restore relaunches whatever is closed onto the right workspace and repositions what is already open instead of duplicating it. Requires node (>= 18) for the restore engine and python3 for browser-tab capture. It does NOT restore the tiled arrangement within a workspace (which window is beside which, split ratios) - Hyprland does not expose that yet; see the README and docs/tiled-layout-restore.md. Forked from Davedes83's Workspace Restorer (MIT).

barWidget.description: Save your open apps and window layout as named sessions, then reopen them on demand from the panel or automatically at login by pinning one. Restores workspace, monitor, position/size, floating and fullscreen state, working directory, and browser tabs; relaunches whatever is missing. Does not restore the tiled split arrangement within a workspace.
